title: Roman Urdu Crisis Detection — Final Report
method: Rules-only hybrid (feature-flagged ROMAN_URDU_RULES_ENABLED, default on). ML parity kit built and validated but NOT trained — training is owner-launched.

dev_evaluation.low_confidence_note: gentle check-in responses; excluded from crisis-FPR by design; never a recall hit

test_evaluation.tier1_crisis_route_recall: 21/32 = 65.62% (Wilson95 case [0.483, 0.796]; skeletons n=16, conservative 0.5625, lower bound 0.332)
test_evaluation.tier2_crisis_route_recall: 25/50 = 50.0% (Wilson95 case [0.366, 0.634]; skeletons n=25, conservative 0.4, lower bound 0.234)

gates.tier1_ge_99_zero_miss: FAIL (65.62%, 11 misses reported by id in test_runs.json)
gates.adversarial_ge_95: FAIL on DEV-adversarial (94.49%); TEST has no separate adversarial gate

gate_failures_honest_summary: DEV numbers (95/90/98) are inflated by same-author overlap with the rules. On the frozen TEST (unseen skeletons) the rules-only system generalizes at 50–66% recall — far below the 99/97 gates. The misses are exactly the unseen-phrasing gap that the ML parity kit (augmented training, 21,748 samples ready) and native-speaker label review are designed to close. Per protocol, TEST was run once and the misses were NOT tuned against.

pattern_review.authorship: ai_assisted_v1 — authored from linguistic coverage (inflections, means, idioms, code-switch anchors), never copied from TEST/TEST-2 text
pattern_review.suppression_scope: span-scoped: contrastive conjunctions + sentence-final punctuation split; commas never split; markers carry across commas

ml_parity_kit.augmented_data: ml/data/roman_urdu_augmented.csv — 21,748 samples (11,008 crisis / 10,740 benign), 107 templates, max template share 1.03% (<=2% PASS), 3-level typo noise + code-switch, exact dedupe (33 benchmark-overlap rows excluded)
ml_parity_kit.training_script: ml/finetune_crisis_roberta_urdu.py (fixed seed 42, temperature scaling, recall-first threshold, candidate dir, promotion gates)
ml_parity_kit.bug_fixed: ml/download_232k_dataset.py drop_duplicates-after-oversample silently nullified the 10x edge-case oversampling
ml_parity_kit.status: NOT TRAINED — owner launches when plugged in (~2-4 h CPU)
